result.topic_en: Gauss expresses the volume of a tetrahedron-like quantity via a Heron-type product, then solves a system of three equations by introducing quantities f, f', f'' and t, t', t'' that turn out to be tangents of three angles summing to 180 degrees.
result.transcription:
Da
$V = \frac{1}{3}\sqrt{\frac{a+a'+a''}{2}\cdot\frac{a+a'-a''}{2}\cdot\frac{a-a'+a''}{2}\cdot\frac{-a+a'+a''}{2}}$
so folgt wenn man für $a, a', a''$ ihre Werthe in $c, c', c''$ substituirt
$3 = \sqrt{(c+c'+c'')(c+c'-c'')(c-c'+c'')(-c+c'+c'')}$
Setzt man
$x+x'' = y''+c''$ so wird $x-x'' = \frac{1}{y'}-c''$
$x'+x = y''+c$ $\quad x'-x = \frac{1}{y''}-c$
$x''+x' = y+c'$ $\quad x''-x' = \frac{1}{y}-c'$
woraus, wenn man $c+c'-c'' = f''$, $c-c'+c'' = f'$; $-c+c'+c'' = f$ setzt
folgt
$1 = y(y'-y'')+fy$
$1 = y'(y''-y)+f'y'$
$1 = y''(y-y')+f''y''$ wo $(f+f'+f'')ff'f'' = 9$
$3 = fy+f'y'+f''y''$
Setzt man
$t = \frac{3}{f'f''}$, $t' = \frac{3}{f''f}$, $t'' = \frac{3}{ff'}$
so wird die Bedingungsgleichung
$t+t'+t'' = \frac{3}{ff'f''}(f+f'+f'') = \frac{27}{(ff'f'')^2} = tt't''$
Es sind also $t, t', t''$ Tangenten dreier Winkel deren Summe $= 180^\circ$
und $f = \sqrt{\frac{3t}{t't''}}$, $f' = \sqrt{\frac{3t'}{t''t}}$, $f'' = \sqrt{\frac{3t''}{tt'}}$
Setzt man auch
$y = z\sqrt{\frac{3}{tt't''}}$, $y' = z'\sqrt{\frac{3}{tt't''}}$, $y'' = z''\sqrt{\frac{3}{tt't''}}$ so werden die drei Gleichungen

methods.what: Heron-type formula for V in terms of a, a', a''
Substitution giving relation in c, c', c''
Reduction of the x-system to equations in y with constants f
Sum identity from adding the three equations
Substitution t = 3/(f'f'') turns the constraint into the tangent identity t+t'+t'' = tt't''
Interpretation: t, t', t'' are tangents of angles summing to 180°
